kpis.description_fr: Charge d'amortissement annuelle des actifs incorporels acquis, incluant les brevets et relations clients.
kpis.description_en: Annual amortization expense of acquired intangible assets, including patents and customer relationships.
kpis._specific_to: Cisco's acquisition-driven growth model and integration of intangible assets from companies like Splunk

kpis.description_fr: Coûts prévisionnels liés aux plans de restructuration, principalement des indemnités de départ.
kpis.description_en: Pre-tax charges related to workforce reductions and operational realignment, primarily severance costs.
kpis._specific_to: Cisco's recurring multi-year restructuring initiatives to optimize operations and reallocate resources

kpis.description_fr: Dépense annuelle liée aux locations opérationnelles d'actifs comme les immeubles et équipements.
kpis.description_en: Annual expense for operating leases of facilities and equipment used in operations.
kpis._specific_to: Cisco's significant real estate and equipment footprint managed through operating leases
